notes.title: 23-06-2021 Update
notes.content:
Hi. With this update you'll find a brand new menu for language selection:

notes.title: Christmas Update 2020
notes.content:

- Added Reindeer Hat accessory. Available at the shop.
- NEW FEATURE: Lighting switch. Now you can switch the lighting mode through the new Lighting button at the top left.

notes.title: 03-04-2020 Update
notes.content:
This update contains the following changes:

[b]-- Mechanics, Design, Bug Fixing, etc --[/b]
    - improved environment's design
    - added a system that adapts accessories to the character's body
    - increased automatic gold earning from 1 gold/ 1.5 seconds to 1 gold/1 second


[b]-- Animations --[/b]

    - new standing 69 anim.
    - new hanging missionaire anim.
    - new crab anim.
    - new inverted facesitting anim.
    - new riding anim.


[b]-- Accessories --[/b]
    - Harnesses price reduced from 400 to 300.
    - Added 2 Harness variations, (pink and red)

    Brand new accessories added:
    - Druid hat
    - Executioner hat
    - B/W mask
    - Nipple Tape
    - NippleHearts00
    - NippleHearts01
    - NippleHearts02

notes.title: St Patrick's Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]New content:[/b][/h1]
- Added St Patrick's hat accessory. Available at the shop for 1 gold.
- Added Duct Tape accessory. Available at the shop for 100 gold.
- Added Surgical Mask accessory. Available at the shop for 150 gold.


[h1][b]Bug fixing:[/b][/h1]
- Fixed accessories illumination.
- Fixed a data saving error: when the game was executed for the very first time, it used lo crash because of the lack of saving file.

[h1][b]Other:[/b][/h1]
- Added some aesthetic UI elements to Shop UI. 
- The gold generation time was reduced from 1 gold/2 seconds to 1 gold/1.5 seconds
